text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One big change is automation. Machines and software can now do repetitive tasks, such as sorting emails or checking data. This saves time and reduces mistakes. There are also many productivity tools that help workers plan their day, organize projects, and communicate with their team. However, AI is not only about replacing people. In many jobs, humans and AI work together. For example, doctors use AI to find diseases faster, but they still make the final decision. Of course, some jobs may disappear, but new ones will appear too. Workers need to learn new skills to stay successful in this changing world.
